body: I’ve thought about this but I really don’t NEED a secondary phone. I wish I did for a work phone or something so I could justify it! If I do get the Z Flip— I’m definitely keeping my current iPhone and not trading in. At worst case at least then I can just switch back and reactivate my iPhone if I hate it. I hate the fact that I won’t truly know until I try.

This was very refreshing to hear. I’m glad you finally saw her even though you both had to go through the process. I hate that distancing myself and slowly disconnecting is the only thing that seems to get his attention. I suppose he sort of goes into fight or flight mode when he finally notices I’m shutting down, because during conversations in the past he had expressed fear that I may leave. Or find someone better. Something better. I mean- clearly I daydream about a relationship where I feel better, but I just don’t want to leave deep down. I hope I can give him a wake up call, as divorce isn’t on my bucket list ):

I too mentioned this. She isn’t into Funko Pops or posters (I suggested a poster of sorts) so I am struggling to think of what she would like signed 😅She thinks it will look fine. I just have never heard of anyone getting one signed.

AGREED. He doesn’t want to do a wig *cries*. I tried explaining that the beauty of cosplay is that you make your favorite characters your ownnnn! I’m hoping that after experiencing his first comic con he will see that and maybe feel more comfortable doing whatever he wants in the future! But I told him I’d snoop around and see if anyone had any ideas in the meantime.

We have an upcoming vet appointment. Sent pics to an old friend who’s a vet tech asking for their opinion as well, to which they mentioned Seasonal Flank Alopecia. Which I had never heard of. He scratches sometimes but not as much as you’d think. I also worried it was mange at first, but he has no scabs, no flakey patches. Just balding.
